title: Sloth wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tree branch -->
  <rect x='6' y='62' width='88' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='6' y='62' width='88' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#A8703C'/>
  <!-- sloth body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='26' ry='16' fill='#B98A55'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='17' ry='10' fill='#E0C08A'/>
  <!-- left arm gripping branch -->
  <path d='M28 50 Q20 52 18 64' stroke='#B98A55' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='66' r='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- right arm gripping branch -->
  <path d='M72 50 Q80 52 82 64' stroke='#B98A55' stroke-width='8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='66' r='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='19' fill='#C79A63'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='37' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#E8D3A8'/>
  <!-- ear tufts -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='24' r='5' fill='#B98A55'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='24' r='5' fill='#B98A55'/>
  <!-- sunglasses lenses -->
  <rect x='34' y='30' width='14' height='10' rx='4' fill='#2B2440'/>
  <rect x='52' y='30' width='14' height='10' rx='4' fill='#2B2440'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x='37' y='32' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7A6BC9'/>
  <rect x='55' y='32' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7A6BC9'/>
  <!-- bridge -->
  <rect x='47' y='33' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2B2440'/>
  <!-- temples -->
  <rect x='28' y='32' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2B2440'/>
  <rect x='66' y='32' width='6' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2B2440'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='45' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#6B4423'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 49 Q50 54 56 49' stroke='#6B4423' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
